title: PcfFindingBundle
description: A single signed-finding bundle (SPEC section 8): ONE governance-signed SignedEvidence plus the TrustRoot it verifies under, as a VIGIL customer downloads it for one finding. It carries no engagement chain, no retained oracle_context and no raw evidence. Verified standalone by `verify_pcf.py finding --bundle <file> --trust-root-fingerprint <out-of-band pin>`. The optional convenience members (trust_root_fingerprint, cert_digest, finding_ref) are never trust anchors: a conforming verifier refuses the bundle when any present one disagrees with the value it recomputes from the signed certificate / trust root.

format.description: The bundle format tag. A verifier refuses any other value.

signed_evidence.description: The one signed certificate and its m-of-n governance signatures (SPEC section 4).

trust_root.description: The governance trust root (PUBLIC keys + threshold). A convenience copy: its authenticity is anchored by the fingerprint the operator publishes out-of-band.

trust_root_fingerprint.description: OPTIONAL convenience copy of "sha256:" + digest_payload(trust_root). Never the anchor: pin the value the operator publishes out-of-band.

about.description: OPTIONAL human-readable note. Never verified, never a claim.
